name: Field Trip to Hidden Villa Farms
description: PARENTS: Return permission slip promptly. Sign up on the Google Doc if you plan to chaperone.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Bring 1 Valentine's card for each of the 22 students in the class. Leave the "To:" section blank. Keep goodies and prizes small.

name: Pajama Day Spirit Day
description: PARENTS: Send child to school in pajamas.

name: Sports-Themed Spirit Day
description: PARENTS: Send child in sports-themed shirt.

name: Label New Items
description: PARENTS: Label new clothes, jackets, and other items with child's name.

name: PTA General Meeting
description: Join us for our next PTA meeting!

name: Variety Show
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show, sign up to share your talent - sing, rap, dance, etc.

name: Variety Show Dress Rehearsal
description: Dress Rehearsal for the Variety Show

name: Variety Show Audition Videos Due
description: Audition videos for the Variety Show are due by this date.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth, fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Due
description: 5th grade parents - start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages in the yearbook. They are due by this date.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!

name: Castillero 6th Grade PTA Volunteers Needed
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.
